propositions: Deterministic Pass 3 of code-review ignores project routing and reads only the packaged routing map, dropping project overlay re-tunes of threshold, blocking, and nit-suppression.
code_review_decide passes threshold_for as a bare callable and calls nit_suppressed_criteria with no arguments, bypassing the optional routing_map parameters.
Fix threads registry.effective_routing(ctx.repo_root) into the Pass-3 threshold_for binding and nit_suppressed_criteria call without changing registry.py.
A project overlay re-tuning project.foo should govern Pass-3 blocking and demotion per project routing rather than the packaged default.
With no overlay, Pass-3 dispositions must remain byte-identical to the packaged-default path (parity).
